facts.text: Deborah finds peace through nature, which she describes as a way to put things into perspective and reflect.

evidence.quote: It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening.

facts.text: Jolene expresses a desire to run with her snakes, believing it would be motivating and more fun.

evidence.quote: It's a pity that my snakes don't run! I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun.

facts.text: Jolene enjoys going for walks and taking photos of natural scenes, such as sunsets over water.

evidence.quote: Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this [image: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]
